hero.filename: USS Newport News (CA-148) firing on North Vietnamese positions on Cồn Cỏ Island on 27 June 1972 (USN 1151898).jpg
hero.caption: The U.S. Navy heavy cruiser USS Newport News (CA-148) firing on North Vietnamese positions on Cồn Cỏ Island (Tiger island) off Cửa Việt, Vietnam, 27 June 1972. She supported a landing of of South Vietnamese Marines.
